text: Most scheduling problems come from a few habits. Here they are, and how to avoid each.
The one thing to remember: let routing book, give the family the window, and close every loop.
One: telling the family the start time. They were promised the window.
Two: booking by hand when routing would have found a better time.
Three: removing a visit and booking a new one instead of rescheduling. And removing without a real reason.
Four: leaving online requests in New. Every one ends Booked or Not booked.
Five: follow-ups sent to the CLs that nobody books.
Six: a hold left on the calendar after the family confirms. A hold gets no reminder.
Seven: telling a family a texted time is booked. It isn't until they confirm.
Eight: when a pet dies, cancelling one visit and leaving the rest. Deactivate closes everything.
Nine: holidays not marked closed, so online booking offers them.
Remember: let routing book, give the family the window, and close every loop: requests, follow-ups, holds and offers.
